lemmas.name: flatten_balanced
lemmas.statement: ∀ (groups : List (List Char)), (∀ g ∈ groups, isBalanced g) → groups.flatten.count '(' = groups.flatten.count ')'
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro groups
  induction groups with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons g t ih =>
    intro h
    have hg := h g (List.mem_cons_self)
    have ht := ih (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
    simp only [List.flatten_cons, List.count_append]
    rw [ht, hg.2]

lemmas.name: step_close
lemmas.statement: ∀ (F : List Char) (i : Nat) (cur : List Char) (groups : List (List Char)), isBalanced F → i < F.length → (i ≤ F.length ∧ (groups).flatten ++ (cur) = F.take i ∧ (∀ g ∈ groups, g ≠ [] ∧ isBalanced g ∧ ∀ k, k < g.length → 0 < k → ¬ isBalanced (g.take k)) ∧ ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ (cur).length → ((cur).take k).count ')' < ((cur).take k).count '(') → (cur ++ [F[i]!]).count '(' = (cur ++ [F[i]!]).count ')' → ((i + 1) ≤ F.length ∧ ((groups ++ [cur ++ [F[i]!]])).flatten ++ ([]) = F.take (i + 1) ∧ (∀ g ∈ (groups ++ [cur ++ [F[i]!]]), g ≠ [] ∧ isBalanced g ∧ ∀ k, k < g.length → 0 < k → ¬ isBalanced (g.take k)) ∧ ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ ([] : List Char).length → (([] : List Char).take k).count ')' < (([] : List Char).take k).count '(')
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro F i cur groups hF hi ⟨hile, hflat, hgroups, hcur⟩ hcl
  have hfi : F.take (i + 1) = F.take i ++ [F[i]!] := Refine.take_succ_bang F i hi
  have hl : (cur ++ [F[i]!]).length = cur.length + 1 := by simp
  have hcur' : isBalanced (cur ++ [F[i]!]) := by
    refine ⟨?_, hcl⟩
    intro k hk
    by_cases hkl : k ≤ cur.length
    · by_cases hk0 : k = 0
      · subst hk0; simp
      · have := hcur k (by omega) hkl
        rw [List.take_append_of_le_length hkl]
        omega
    · have hk' : k = (cur ++ [F[i]!]).length := by omega
      subst hk'
      rw [List.take_length]
      omega
  have hminimal : ∀ k, k < (cur ++ [F[i]!]).length → 0 < k → ¬ isBalanced ((cur ++ [F[i]!]).take k) := by
    intro k hk hk0 hb
    have hkl : k ≤ cur.length := by omega
    rw [List.take_append_of_le_length hkl] at hb
    have h1 := hcur k hk0 hkl
    have h2 := hb.2
    omega
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hfi, List.flatten_append, ← hflat]
    simp
  · intro g hg
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hg with hg | hg
    · exact hgroups g hg
    · have : g = cur ++ [F[i]!] := by simpa using hg
      subst this
      exact ⟨by simp, hcur', hminimal⟩
  · intro k hk hkl
    have : k ≤ 0 := by simpa using hkl
    omega

lemmas.name: step_open
lemmas.statement: ∀ (F : List Char) (i : Nat) (cur : List Char) (groups : List (List Char)), isBalanced F → i < F.length → (i ≤ F.length ∧ (groups).flatten ++ (cur) = F.take i ∧ (∀ g ∈ groups, g ≠ [] ∧ isBalanced g ∧ ∀ k, k < g.length → 0 < k → ¬ isBalanced (g.take k)) ∧ ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ (cur).length → ((cur).take k).count ')' < ((cur).take k).count '(') → ¬ (cur ++ [F[i]!]).count '(' = (cur ++ [F[i]!]).count ')' → ((i + 1) ≤ F.length ∧ (groups).flatten ++ ((cur ++ [F[i]!])) = F.take (i + 1) ∧ (∀ g ∈ groups, g ≠ [] ∧ isBalanced g ∧ ∀ k, k < g.length → 0 < k → ¬ isBalanced (g.take k)) ∧ ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ ((cur ++ [F[i]!])).length → (((cur ++ [F[i]!])).take k).count ')' < (((cur ++ [F[i]!])).take k).count '(')
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro F i cur groups hF hi ⟨hile, hflat, hgroups, hcur⟩ hne
  have hfi : F.take (i + 1) = F.take i ++ [F[i]!] := Refine.take_succ_bang F i hi
  have hflatbal := flatten_balanced groups (fun g hg => (hgroups g hg).2.1)
  have hpre : (F.take (i + 1)).count ')' ≤ (F.take (i + 1)).count '(' := hF.1 (i + 1) (by omega)
  have heq : F.take (i + 1) = groups.flatten ++ cur ++ [F[i]!] := by rw [hfi, ← hflat]
  rw [heq] at hpre
  simp only [List.count_append] at hpre hne
  have hsum : (cur ++ [F[i]!]).count ')' ≤ (cur ++ [F[i]!]).count '(' := by
    simp only [List.count_append]
    omega
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_, hgroups, ?_⟩
  · rw [hfi, ← hflat, List.append_assoc]
  · intro k hk hkl
    by_cases hkc : k ≤ cur.length
    · have htake : (cur ++ [F[i]!]).take k = cur.take k := List.take_append_of_le_length hkc
      rw [htake]
      exact hcur k hk hkc
    · have hl : (cur ++ [F[i]!]).length = cur.length + 1 := by simp
      have hk' : k = (cur ++ [F[i]!]).length := by omega
      subst hk'
      rw [List.take_length]
      simp only [List.count_append] at hsum ⊢
      omega

lemmas.name: separate_exit
lemmas.statement: ∀ (F : List Char) (cur : List Char) (groups : List (List Char)), isBalanced F → (F.length ≤ F.length ∧ (groups).flatten ++ (cur) = F.take F.length ∧ (∀ g ∈ groups, g ≠ [] ∧ isBalanced g ∧ ∀ k, k < g.length → 0 < k → ¬ isBalanced (g.take k)) ∧ ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ (cur).length → ((cur).take k).count ')' < ((cur).take k).count '(') → ((groups.map String.mk).map String.toList).flatten = F ∧ ∀ g ∈ groups.map String.mk, g.length > 0 ∧ isBalanced g.toList ∧ ∀ k, k < g.length → 0 < k → ¬ isBalanced (g.toList.take k)
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro F cur groups hF ⟨_, hflat, hgroups, hcur⟩
  have hflatbal := flatten_balanced groups (fun g hg => (hgroups g hg).2.1)
  have hcurnil : cur = [] := by
    by_contra hne
    have hlen : 0 < cur.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne
    have h1 := hcur cur.length hlen (le_refl _)
    rw [List.take_length] at h1
    rw [List.take_length] at hflat
    have hFtot : F.count '(' = F.count ')' := hF.2
    rw [← hflat] at hFtot
    simp only [List.count_append] at hFtot
    omega
  subst hcurnil
  have hF' : groups.flatten = F := by simpa [List.take_length] using hflat
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.map_map]
    have : (String.toList ∘ String.mk) = fun g => g := by
      funext g; simp [Function.comp, Refine.string_toList_mk]
    rw [this, List.map_id']
    exact hF'
  · intro g hg
    obtain ⟨g0, hg0, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hg
    obtain ⟨hne, hbal, hmin⟩ := hgroups g0 hg0
    rw [Refine.string_length_mk, Refine.string_toList_mk]
    refine ⟨List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne, hbal, hmin⟩

lemmas.name: append_pair_idx

  by_cases h : j < a.length
  · rw [if_pos h]; exact Refine.getElem_bang_append_lt a [d, x] j h
  · rw [if_neg h]
    simp only [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega : a.length ≤ j)]
    by_cases h2 : j = a.length
    · subst h2; simp
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      by_cases h3 : j = a.length + 1
      · subst h3; simp

        simp [List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp; omega : [d, x].length ≤ j - a.length)]

lemmas.name: foldl_max_facts

lemmas.proof:
by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro m; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro m
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (max m a)
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases h1 with h | h
      · by_cases hm : m ≤ a
        · right; rw [max_eq_right hm] at h ⊢; rw [h]; simp
        · left
          have hmx : max m a = m := max_eq_left (by omega)
          rw [hmx] at h ⊢; exact h
      · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a h
    · exact le_trans (le_max_left m a) h2
    · intro x hx
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
      · exact le_trans (le_max_right m x) h2
      · exact h3 x hx'

lemmas.name: rolling_ok

lemmas.proof:
by
  intro numbers
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hget : ((List.range numbers.length).map (fun i => (numbers.take (i + 1)).foldl max numbers[0]!))[i]! =
      (numbers.take (i + 1)).foldl max numbers[0]! := by
    rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by simpa using hi)]
    simp
  rw [hget]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := foldl_max_facts (numbers.take (i + 1)) numbers[0]!
  refine ⟨?_, h3⟩
  rcases h1 with h | h
  · rw [h]
    have : numbers[0]! ∈ numbers.take (i + 1) := by
      rw [getElem!_pos numbers 0 (by omega)]
      exact List.mem_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨0, by simp; omega, by simp⟩
    exact this
  · exact h

lemmas.name: maxmin_abs

by

lemmas.name: closest_yes
lemmas.statement: ∀ (numbers : List ℚ) (i j : Nat) (lo hi : ℚ), i < j → j < numbers.length → ((lo ≤ hi ∧ (∃ b, b < (j + 1) ∧ ∃ a, a < b ∧ ((lo = numbers[a]! ∧ hi = numbers[b]!) ∨ (lo = numbers[b]! ∧ hi = numbers[a]!))) ∧ (∀ b, b < j → ∀ a, a < b → hi - lo ≤ |numbers[a]! - numbers[b]!|) ∧ (∀ a, a < i → hi - lo ≤ |numbers[a]! - numbers[j]!|)) ∧ i ≤ j) → |numbers[i]! - numbers[j]!| < hi - lo → (((min numbers[i]! numbers[j]!) ≤ (max numbers[i]! numbers[j]!) ∧ (∃ b, b < (j + 1) ∧ ∃ a, a < b ∧ (((min numbers[i]! numbers[j]!) = numbers[a]! ∧ (max numbers[i]! numbers[j]!) = numbers[b]!) ∨ ((min numbers[i]! numbers[j]!) = numbers[b]! ∧ (max numbers[i]! numbers[j]!) = numbers[a]!))) ∧ (∀ b, b < j → ∀ a, a < b → (max numbers[i]! numbers[j]!) - (min numbers[i]! numbers[j]!) ≤ |numbers[a]! - numbers[b]!|) ∧ (∀ a, a < (i + 1) → (max numbers[i]! numbers[j]!) - (min numbers[i]! numbers[j]!) ≤ |numbers[a]! - numbers[j]!|)) ∧ i + 1 ≤ j)
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro numbers i j lo hi hij hj ⟨⟨hle, hex, hbest, hall⟩, hi'⟩ hc
  have hm := maxmin_abs numbers[i]! numbers[j]!
  have hmle : min numbers[i]! numbers[j]! ≤ max numbers[i]! numbers[j]! := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨⟨hmle, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
  · refine ⟨j, by omega, i, hij, ?_⟩
    rcases le_total numbers[i]! numbers[j]! with h | h
    · left; exact ⟨min_eq_left h, max_eq_right h⟩
    · right; exact ⟨min_eq_right h, max_eq_left h⟩
  · intro b hb a ha
    have := hbest b hb a ha
    linarith
  · intro a ha
    by_cases hai : a < i
    · have := hall a hai
      linarith
    · have : a = i := by omega
      subst this
      linarith

lemmas.name: closest_no

  intro numbers i j lo hi hij hj ⟨⟨hle, hex, hbest, hall⟩, hi'⟩ hc

  refine ⟨⟨hle, hex, hbest, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
  intro a ha

  · have : a = i := by omega
    subst this
    exact hc

lemmas.name: closest_inner_init
lemmas.statement: ∀ (numbers : List ℚ) (j : Nat) (lo hi : ℚ), ((lo ≤ hi ∧ (∃ b, b < j ∧ ∃ a, a < b ∧ ((lo = numbers[a]! ∧ hi = numbers[b]!) ∨ (lo = numbers[b]! ∧ hi = numbers[a]!))) ∧ (∀ b, b < j → ∀ a, a < b → hi - lo ≤ |numbers[a]! - numbers[b]!|)) ∧ 2 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ numbers.length) → ((lo ≤ hi ∧ (∃ b, b < (j + 1) ∧ ∃ a, a < b ∧ ((lo = numbers[a]! ∧ hi = numbers[b]!) ∨ (lo = numbers[b]! ∧ hi = numbers[a]!))) ∧ (∀ b, b < j → ∀ a, a < b → hi - lo ≤ |numbers[a]! - numbers[b]!|) ∧ (∀ a, a < 0 → hi - lo ≤ |numbers[a]! - numbers[j]!|)) ∧ 0 ≤ j)

    exact ⟨b, by omega, a, ha, h⟩

lemmas.name: fact_div
lemmas.statement: ∀ (N n d : Nat) (acc : List Nat), (1 ≤ n ∧ 2 ≤ d ∧ (acc).prod * n = N ∧ (∀ p ∈ acc, Nat.Prime p ∧ p < d + 1) ∧ (∀ i, i < (acc).length - 1 → (acc)[i]! ≤ (acc)[i + 1]!) ∧ (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → k < d → ¬ k ∣ n) ∧ (n = 1 ∨ d ≤ n)) → 1 < n → n % d = 0 → ((1 ≤ (n / d) ∧ 2 ≤ d ∧ ((acc ++ [d])).prod * (n / d) = N ∧ (∀ p ∈ (acc ++ [d]), Nat.Prime p ∧ p < d + 1) ∧ (∀ i, i < ((acc ++ [d])).length - 1 → ((acc ++ [d]))[i]! ≤ ((acc ++ [d]))[i + 1]!) ∧ (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → k < d → ¬ k ∣ (n / d)) ∧ ((n / d) = 1 ∨ d ≤ (n / d))) ∧ ((n / d + n / d - d) < (n + n - d)))
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro N n d acc ⟨h1, h2, hprod, hprime, hsort, hno, hle⟩ hn hd
  have hdd : d ∣ n := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hd
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by omega
  have hdn : d ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdd
  have hdprime : Nat.Prime d := by
    rw [Nat.prime_def_lt]
    refine ⟨h2, ?_⟩
    intro m hm hmd
    by_contra hm1
    have hm2 : 2 ≤ m := by
      have : m ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0; subst h0; simp at hmd; omega
      omega
    exact hno m hm2 hm (Nat.dvd_trans hmd hdd)
  have hq : n / d < n := Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) (by omega)
  have hqpos : 1 ≤ n / d := by
    have := Nat.div_pos hdn hdpos
    omega
  have hmul : d * (n / d) = n := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdd
  refine ⟨⟨hqpos, h2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
  · rw [List.prod_append]
    simp only [List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, Nat.mul_one]
    calc acc.prod * d * (n / d) = acc.prod * (d * (n / d)) := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
      _ = N := by rw [hmul]; exact hprod
  · intro p hp
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hp with hp | hp
    · exact hprime p hp
    · have : p = d := by simpa using hp
      subst this
      exact ⟨hdprime, by omega⟩
  · intro i hi
    have hlen : (acc ++ [d]).length = acc.length + 1 := by simp
    rw [hlen] at hi
    by_cases hlast : i + 1 < acc.length
    · rw [getElem!_pos (acc ++ [d]) i (by simp; omega), getElem!_pos (acc ++ [d]) (i + 1) (by simp; omega)]
      simp only [List.getElem_append_left (by omega : i < acc.length), List.getElem_append_left hlast]
      have := hsort i (by omega)
      rwa [getElem!_pos acc i (by omega), getElem!_pos acc (i + 1) hlast] at this
    · have hi' : i + 1 = acc.length := by omega
      rw [getElem!_pos (acc ++ [d]) i (by simp; omega), getElem!_pos (acc ++ [d]) (i + 1) (by simp; omega)]
      have hmem : (acc ++ [d])[i]'(by simp; omega) ∈ acc := by
        rw [List.getElem_append_left (by omega)]; exact List.getElem_mem _
      have hlt := (hprime _ hmem).2
      have hlast' : (acc ++ [d])[i + 1]'(by simp; omega) = d := by
        rw [List.getElem_append_right (by omega)]; simp [hi']
      rw [hlast']
      omega
  · intro k hk2 hkd hkq
    exact hno k hk2 hkd (Nat.dvd_trans hkq (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hdd))
  · by_cases hq1 : n / d = 1
    · left; exact hq1
    · right
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpq⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hq1
      have hpn : p ∣ n := Nat.dvd_trans hpq (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hdd)
      have hpd : d ≤ p := by
        by_contra hlt
        exact hno p hp.two_le (by omega) hpn
      exact le_trans hpd (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hpq)

lemmas.proof:
by
  intro N n d acc ⟨h1, h2, hprod, hprime, hsort, hno, hle⟩ hn hd

    intro h; subst h; simp at hd
  refine ⟨⟨h1, by omega, hprod, ?_, hsort, ?_, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := hprime p hp
    exact ⟨a, by omega⟩
  · intro k hk2 hkd hkn
    by_cases hkdd : k = d
    · subst hkdd; exact hd (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hkn)
    · exact hno k hk2 (by omega) hkn
  · right; omega

  intro l

lemmas.name: round_sqrt_ok
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro A hA
  set N := ⌊40000 * A⌋₊ with hN
  set m := Nat.sqrt N with hm
  set k := (m + 1) / 2 with hk
  have h1 : (m : ℚ) ^ 2 ≤ 40000 * A := by
    have hsq : m * m ≤ N := Nat.sqrt_le N
    have hfl : (N : ℚ) ≤ 40000 * A := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
    have : ((m * m : Nat) : ℚ) ≤ (N : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hsq
    push_cast at this
    nlinarith
  have h2 : 40000 * A < ((m : ℚ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
    have hsq : N < (m + 1) * (m + 1) := Nat.lt_succ_sqrt N
    have hfl : 40000 * A < (N : ℚ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have : ((N + 1 : Nat) : ℚ) ≤ (((m + 1) * (m + 1) : Nat) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hsq
    push_cast at this
    nlinarith
  have hk1 : 2 * k ≤ m + 1 := by omega
  have hk2 : m ≤ 2 * k := by omega
  have hk1' : (2 * (k : ℚ)) ≤ (m : ℚ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hk1
  have hk2' : (m : ℚ) ≤ 2 * (k : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hk2
  refine ⟨by positivity, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : ((k : ℚ) / 100) * 100 = (k : ℚ) := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact Rat.den_natCast k
  · by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · left; rw [hk0]; norm_num
    · right
      have hkpos : (1 : ℚ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hk0
      have hm1 : 2 * (k : ℚ) - 1 ≤ (m : ℚ) := by linarith
      have hm0 : 0 ≤ 2 * (k : ℚ) - 1 := by linarith
      have : (2 * (k : ℚ) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ (m : ℚ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have : ((k : ℚ) / 100 - 1 / 200) ^ 2 = (2 * (k : ℚ) - 1) ^ 2 / 40000 := by ring
      rw [this]
      linarith
  · have : (m : ℚ) + 1 ≤ 2 * (k : ℚ) + 1 := by linarith
    have hm0 : 0 ≤ (m : ℚ) + 1 := by positivity
    have : ((m : ℚ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * (k : ℚ) + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have e : ((k : ℚ) / 100 + 1 / 200) ^ 2 = (2 * (k : ℚ) + 1) ^ 2 / 40000 := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith

lemmas.name: toDigits2_binary
lemmas.statement: ∀ (v : Nat), isBinary (Nat.toDigits 2 v) v
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro v
  induction v using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ v ih =>
    by_cases h0 : v = 0
    · subst h0
      simp [isBinary, Nat.toDigits, Nat.toDigitsCore]
    · by_cases h1 : v / 2 = 0
      · have hv : v = 1 := by omega
        subst hv
        simp [isBinary, Nat.toDigits, Nat.toDigitsCore]
      · have hlt : v / 2 < v := by omega
        have ihv := ih (v / 2) hlt
        have hsplit : Nat.toDigits 2 v = Nat.toDigits 2 (v / 2) ++ Nat.toDigits 2 (v % 2) := by
          rw [Nat.toDigits_append_toDigits (by norm_num) (by omega) (by omega)]
          congr 1; omega
        have hbit : Nat.toDigits 2 (v % 2) = [if v % 2 = 1 then '1' else '0'] := by
          rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one v with h | h <;> simp [h, Nat.toDigits, Nat.toDigitsCore]
        rw [hsplit, hbit]
        obtain ⟨ha, hf, _, hh⟩ := ihv

          split <;> simp
        · rw [List.foldl_append, hf]
          simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
          split <;> simp_all <;> omega
        · intro hz; omega
        · intro _
          have hh' := hh (by omega)
          cases hA : Nat.toDigits 2 (v / 2) with
          | nil => rw [hA] at hh'; simp at hh'
          | cons a t => rw [hA] at hh'; simpa using hh'

lemmas.statement: ∀ (lst : List (List Int)) (x : Int), (∀ p ∈ (List.range lst.length).flatMap (fun i => (((List.range (lst[i]!).length).filter (fun j => (lst[i]!)[j]! == x)).reverse).map (fun j => (i, j))), p.1 < lst.length ∧ p.2 < lst[p.1]!.length ∧ (lst[p.1]!)[p.2]! = x) ∧ (∀ i, i < lst.length → ∀ j, j < lst[i]!.length → (lst[i]!)[j]! = x → (i, j) ∈ (List.range lst.length).flatMap (fun i => (((List.range (lst[i]!).length).filter (fun j => (lst[i]!)[j]! == x)).reverse).map (fun j => (i, j)))) ∧ ((List.range lst.length).flatMap (fun i => (((List.range (lst[i]!).length).filter (fun j => (lst[i]!)[j]! == x)).reverse).map (fun j => (i, j)))).Nodup ∧ (∀ k, k < ((List.range lst.length).flatMap (fun i => (((List.range (lst[i]!).length).filter (fun j => (lst[i]!)[j]! == x)).reverse).map (fun j => (i, j)))).length - 1 → ((List.range lst.length).flatMap (fun i => (((List.range (lst[i]!).length).filter (fun j => (lst[i]!)[j]! == x)).reverse).map (fun j => (i, j))))[k]!.1 < ((List.range lst.length).flatMap (fun i => (((List.range (lst[i]!).length).filter (fun j => (lst[i]!)[j]! == x)).reverse).map (fun j => (i, j))))[k + 1]!.1 ∨ (((List.range lst.length).flatMap (fun i => (((List.range (lst[i]!).length).filter (fun j => (lst[i]!)[j]! == x)).reverse).map (fun j => (i, j))))[k]!.1 = ((List.range lst.length).flatMap (fun i => (((List.range (lst[i]!).length).filter (fun j => (lst[i]!)[j]! == x)).reverse).map (fun j => (i, j))))[k + 1]!.1 ∧ ((List.range lst.length).flatMap (fun i => (((List.range (lst[i]!).length).filter (fun j => (lst[i]!)[j]! == x)).reverse).map (fun j => (i, j))))[k + 1]!.2 < ((List.range lst.length).flatMap (fun i => (((List.range (lst[i]!).length).filter (fun j => (lst[i]!)[j]! == x)).reverse).map (fun j => (i, j))))[k]!.2))

lemmas.proof:
by
  intro lst m p ⟨⟨k0, hk0, hm⟩, hmin⟩ ⟨hiff, hd⟩ hp x hx y hy
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := (Refine.mem_iff_idx lst x).mp hx
  obtain ⟨j2, hj2, rfl⟩ := (Refine.mem_iff_idx lst y).mp hy
  have h1 : ¬ m < lst[j]! := fun h => hp (hiff.mpr ⟨j, hj, h⟩)
  have h2 : ¬ m < lst[j2]! := fun h => hp (hiff.mpr ⟨j2, hj2, h⟩)
  have := hmin j hj
  have := hmin j2 hj2
  omega

lemmas.name: round_away_ok
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro q
  by_cases hq : q ≥ 0
  · rw [if_pos hq]
    have h1 : ((⌊q + 1 / 2⌋ : Int) : ℚ) ≤ q + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le _
    have h2 : q + 1 / 2 < ((⌊q + 1 / 2⌋ : Int) : ℚ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have h3 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ ((⌊q + 1 / 2⌋ : Int) : ℚ) := by
      have : (0 : Int) ≤ ⌊q + 1 / 2⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (by linarith)
      exact_mod_cast this
    set r : ℚ := ((⌊q + 1 / 2⌋ : Int) : ℚ) with hr
    by_cases hlt : q - r > -(1 / 2)
    · left
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    · right
      have heq : q - r = -(1 / 2) := by linarith
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [heq]; norm_num
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg hq, abs_of_nonneg h3]; linarith
  · rw [if_neg hq]
    push_neg at hq
    have h1 : ((⌊-q + 1 / 2⌋ : Int) : ℚ) ≤ -q + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le _
    have h2 : -q + 1 / 2 < ((⌊-q + 1 / 2⌋ : Int) : ℚ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have h3 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ ((⌊-q + 1 / 2⌋ : Int) : ℚ) := by
      have : (0 : Int) ≤ ⌊-q + 1 / 2⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (by linarith)
      exact_mod_cast this
    set r : ℚ := ((⌊-q + 1 / 2⌋ : Int) : ℚ) with hr
    have hcast : (((-⌊-q + 1 / 2⌋ : Int)) : ℚ) = -r := by push_cast; rfl
    rw [hcast]
    by_cases hlt : (-q) - r > -(1 / 2)
    · left
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    · right
      have heq : (-q) - r = -(1 / 2) := by linarith
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [show q - -r = -((-q) - r) by ring, abs_neg, heq]; norm_num
      · rw [abs_of_neg hq, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg h3]; linarith

lemmas.name: toDigits2_binary
lemmas.statement: ∀ (v : Nat), isBinary (Nat.toDigits 2 v) v
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro v
  induction v using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ v ih =>
    by_cases h0 : v = 0
    · subst h0
      simp [isBinary, Nat.toDigits, Nat.toDigitsCore]
    · by_cases h1 : v / 2 = 0
      · have hv : v = 1 := by omega
        subst hv
        simp [isBinary, Nat.toDigits, Nat.toDigitsCore]
      · have hlt : v / 2 < v := by omega
        have ihv := ih (v / 2) hlt
        have hsplit : Nat.toDigits 2 v = Nat.toDigits 2 (v / 2) ++ Nat.toDigits 2 (v % 2) := by
          rw [Nat.toDigits_append_toDigits (by norm_num) (by omega) (by omega)]
          congr 1; omega
        have hbit : Nat.toDigits 2 (v % 2) = [if v % 2 = 1 then '1' else '0'] := by
          rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one v with h | h <;> simp [h, Nat.toDigits, Nat.toDigitsCore]
        rw [hsplit, hbit]
        obtain ⟨ha, hf, _, hh⟩ := ihv
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [List.all_append, Bool.and_eq_true] 
          refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
          split <;> simp
        · rw [List.foldl_append, hf]
          simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
          split <;> simp_all <;> omega
        · intro hz; omega
        · intro _
          have hh' := hh (by omega)
          cases hA : Nat.toDigits 2 (v / 2) with
          | nil => rw [hA] at hh'; simp at hh'
          | cons a t => rw [hA] at hh'; simpa using hh'

lemmas.name: sortNat_ok

lemmas.proof:
by
  intro L
  have hp : (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))).Perm L := List.mergeSort_perm L _
  refine ⟨List.isPerm_iff.mpr hp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hs : List.Pairwise (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b) = true) (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))) :=
    List.pairwise_mergeSort (by intro a b c h1 h2; simp at *; omega) (by intro a b; simp; omega) L
  rw [List.pairwise_iff_getElem] at hs
  have hi' : i + 1 < (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))).length := by omega
  have := hs i (i + 1) (by omega) hi' (by omega)
  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by omega), getElem!_pos _ (i + 1) hi']

lemmas.name: foldl_max_nat
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Nat) (m : Nat), (List.foldl max m l = m ∨ List.foldl max m l ∈ l) ∧ m ≤ List.foldl max m l ∧ ∀ x ∈ l, x ≤ List.foldl max m l
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro m; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro m
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (max m a)
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases h1 with h | h
      · by_cases hm : m ≤ a
        · right; rw [max_eq_right hm] at h ⊢; rw [h]; simp
        · left
          have hmx : max m a = m := max_eq_left (by omega)
          rw [hmx] at h ⊢; exact h
      · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a h
    · exact le_trans (le_max_left m a) h2
    · intro x hx
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
      · exact le_trans (le_max_right m x) h2
      · exact h3 x hx'

lemmas.name: hist_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (ws : List String), ((ws = [] → ((ws.dedup.filter (fun w => ws.count w == (ws.map (fun w => ws.count w)).foldl max 0)).map (fun w => (w, ws.count w))) = []) ∧ (ws ≠ [] → (∀ p ∈ (ws.dedup.filter (fun w => ws.count w == (ws.map (fun w => ws.count w)).foldl max 0)).map (fun w => (w, ws.count w)), p.1 ∈ ws ∧ p.2 = ws.count p.1 ∧ ∀ w ∈ ws, ws.count w ≤ p.2) ∧ (∀ w ∈ ws, (∀ v ∈ ws, ws.count v ≤ ws.count w) → ∃ p ∈ (ws.dedup.filter (fun w => ws.count w == (ws.map (fun w => ws.count w)).foldl max 0)).map (fun w => (w, ws.count w)), p.1 = w) ∧ (((ws.dedup.filter (fun w => ws.count w == (ws.map (fun w => ws.count w)).foldl max 0)).map (fun w => (w, ws.count w))).map Prod.fst).Nodup))
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro ws
  refine ⟨fun h => by subst h; simp, ?_⟩
  intro hne
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := foldl_max_nat (ws.map (fun w => ws.count w)) 0
  have hnd : (ws.dedup.filter (fun w => ws.count w == (ws.map (fun w => ws.count w)).foldl max 0)).Nodup :=
    (List.nodup_dedup ws).filter _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp
    rw [List.mem_filter] at hw
    obtain ⟨hwd, hwb⟩ := hw
    have hwm : w ∈ ws := List.mem_dedup.mp hwd
    have hbeq : ws.count w = (ws.map (fun w => ws.count w)).foldl max 0 := by simpa using hwb
    refine ⟨hwm, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    rw [hbeq]
    exact h3 _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩)
  · intro w hw hmax
    have hbest : (ws.map (fun w => ws.count w)).foldl max 0 = ws.count w := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · rcases h1 with h | h
        · rw [h]; exact Nat.zero_le _
        · obtain ⟨v, hv, hveq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
          rw [← hveq]; exact hmax v hv
      · exact h3 _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩)
    refine ⟨(w, ws.count w), List.mem_map.mpr ⟨w, ?_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [List.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨List.mem_dedup.mpr hw, by simpa [hbest]⟩
  · rw [List.map_map]
    have hc : (Prod.fst ∘ fun w => (w, ws.count w)) = fun w => w := rfl
    rw [hc, List.map_id']
    exact hnd

lemmas.name: minsub_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int), nums ≠ [] → (∃ j, j ≤ nums.length ∧ ∃ i, i < j ∧ ((nums.drop i).take (j - i)).sum = List.foldl min nums[0]! ((List.range (nums.length + 1)).flatMap (fun j => (List.range j).map (fun i => ((nums.drop i).take (j - i)).sum)))) ∧ ∀ j, j ≤ nums.length → ∀ i, i < j → List.foldl min nums[0]! ((List.range (nums.length + 1)).flatMap (fun j => (List.range j).map (fun i => ((nums.drop i).take (j - i)).sum))) ≤ ((nums.drop i).take (j - i)).sum
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro nums hne
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := foldl_min_facts ((List.range (nums.length + 1)).flatMap (fun j => (List.range j).map (fun i => ((nums.drop i).take (j - i)).sum))) nums[0]!
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases h1 with h | h
    · have hlen : 0 < nums.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne
      refine ⟨1, by omega, 0, by omega, ?_⟩
      rw [h]
      cases nums with
      | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
      | cons a t => simp
    · rw [List.mem_flatMap] at h
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hi⟩ := h
      rw [List.mem_map] at hi
      obtain ⟨i, hi', hs⟩ := hi
      rw [List.mem_range] at hj hi'
      exact ⟨j, by omega, i, hi', hs⟩
  · intro j hj i hi
    apply h3
    rw [List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨j, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), List.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, List.mem_range.mpr hi, rfl⟩⟩

lemmas.name: sort116_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (L : List Int), (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (ones a < ones b) || (ones a == ones b && decide (a ≤ b)))).isPerm L = true ∧ ∀ i, i < (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (ones a < ones b) || (ones a == ones b && decide (a ≤ b)))).length - 1 → (ones (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (ones a < ones b) || (ones a == ones b && decide (a ≤ b))))[i]! < ones (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (ones a < ones b) || (ones a == ones b && decide (a ≤ b))))[i + 1]! ∨ (ones (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (ones a < ones b) || (ones a == ones b && decide (a ≤ b))))[i]! = ones (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (ones a < ones b) || (ones a == ones b && decide (a ≤ b))))[i + 1]! ∧ (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (ones a < ones b) || (ones a == ones b && decide (a ≤ b))))[i]! ≤ (L.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (ones a < ones b) || (ones a == ones b && decide (a ≤ b))))[i + 1]!))
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro L
  have htrans : ∀ (a b c : Int), (decide (ones a < ones b) || (ones a == ones b && decide (a ≤ b))) = true →
      (decide (ones b < ones c) || (ones b == ones c && decide (b ≤ c))) = true →
      (decide (ones a < ones c) || (ones a == ones c && decide (a ≤ c))) = true := by
    intro a b c h1 h2

lemmas.name: lexmin_facts
lemmas.statement: ∀ (L : List (List Nat)) (init : List Nat) (seen : List (List Nat)), (∀ c ∈ seen, ¬ c < init) → (∀ c ∈ seen ++ L, ¬ c < List.foldl (fun b c => if c < b then c else b) init L) ∧ (List.foldl (fun b c => if c < b then c else b) init L = init ∨ List.foldl (fun b c => if c < b then c else b) init L ∈ L)

by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro init seen h; exact ⟨by simpa using h, Or.inl rfl⟩
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro init seen h
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    by_cases hx : x < init
    · rw [if_pos hx]
      have h' : ∀ c ∈ seen ++ [x], ¬ c < x := by
        intro c hc
        rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with hc | hc
        · intro hcx; exact h c hc (List.lt_trans hcx hx)
        · have : c = x := by simpa using hc
          subst this; exact List.lt_irrefl c
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih x (seen ++ [x]) h'
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro c hc
        apply h1
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hc ⊢
        rcases hc with hc | hc | hc
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hc)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hc)
        · exact Or.inr hc
      · rcases h2 with h2 | h2
        · right; rw [h2]; exact List.mem_cons_self
        · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h2
    · rw [if_neg hx]
      have h' : ∀ c ∈ seen ++ [x], ¬ c < init := by
        intro c hc
        rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with hc | hc
        · exact h c hc
        · have : c = x := by simpa using hc
          subst this; exact hx
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih init (seen ++ [x]) h'
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro c hc
        apply h1
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hc ⊢
        rcases hc with hc | hc | hc
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hc)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hc)
        · exact Or.inr hc
      · rcases h2 with h2 | h2
        · left; exact h2
        · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h2

lemmas.name: walks_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n → ∀ (k : Nat), walksOf n (k + 1) ≠ [] ∧ ∀ w ∈ walksOf n (k + 1), w ≠ [] ∧ w.getLast! ∈ gridCells n
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro n hn k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have h00 : ((0, 0) : Nat × Nat) ∈ gridCells n := (grid_mem n 0 0).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [walksOf]
      intro h
      have hm : [((0, 0) : Nat × Nat)] ∈ (gridCells n).map (fun c => [c]) := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(0, 0), h00, rfl⟩
      rw [h] at hm
      simp at hm
    · intro w hw
      rw [walksOf, List.mem_map] at hw
      obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hw
      exact ⟨by simp, by simpa using hc⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hne, hall⟩ := ih
    rw [show k + 1 + 1 = k + 2 from rfl, walksOf]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hne
      obtain ⟨hwne, hwl⟩ := hall w hw
      have hs := steps_ne n hn _ hwl
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hs

        List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨w, hw, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩⟩
      rw [h] at this
      simp at this
    · intro w' hw'
      rw [List.mem_flatMap] at hw'
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hq⟩ := hw'
      rw [List.mem_map] at hq
      obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := hq
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩

        exact (List.mem_filter.mp hq).1
      simpa using this

  unfold FindSingleNumber_postcond
  obtain ⟨hall, hcnt⟩ := h
  have h1mem : 1 ∈ nums.map (fun x => nums.count x) := List.count_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0, hc0⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h1mem
  have hany : nums.any (fun x => decide (nums.count x = 1)) = true := List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨x0, hx0, by simpa using hc0⟩

  have e : (nums.find? (fun x => decide (nums.count x = 1))).getD 0 = r := by rw [hr]; rfl

  have hflen : ∀ y, (filterlist y nums).length = nums.count y := by
    intro y; rw [fl_eq]; exact fl_count nums y
  refine ⟨List.length_pos_of_mem hrmem, by rw [hflen, hcr], ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxr : x = r
  · exact Or.inl hxr
  · right
    rw [hflen]
    have hx12 := List.all_eq_true.mp hall _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hx12
    rcases hx12 with h1 | h2
    · exfalso
      have := pair_le_countP nums (fun y => decide (nums.count y = 1)) x r hxr (by simpa using h1) (by simpa using hcr)
      have hc : (nums.map (fun x => nums.count x)).count 1 = nums.countP (fun y => decide (nums.count y = 1)) := by
        rw [List.count_eq_countP, List.countP_map]; rfl

      have hrl : (nums.filter (fun y => decide (y = r))).length = 1 := by rw [fl_count]; exact hcr
      omega
    · exact h2

lemmas.name: argmin_facts
lemmas.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (f : α → Nat) (L : List α) (b : α), (L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b = b ∨ L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b ∈ L) ∧ f (L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b) ≤ f b ∧ ∀ y ∈ L, f (L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b) ≤ f y

by
  intro α f L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro b; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro b
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    by_cases hlt : f a < f b
    · rw [if_pos hlt]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih a
      refine ⟨?_, by omega, ?_⟩
      · rcases h1 with h | h
        · right; rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self
        · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a h
      · intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
        · exact h2
        · exact h3 x hx'
    · rw [if_neg hlt]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih b
      refine ⟨?_, h2, ?_⟩
      · rcases h1 with h | h
        · left; exact h
        · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a h
      · intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
        · omega
        · exact h3 x hx'

lemmas.statement: ∀ {α β : Type} [LinearOrder β] (f : α → β) (L : List α) (b : α), (L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b = b ∨ L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b ∈ L) ∧ f (L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b) ≤ f b ∧ ∀ y ∈ L, f (L.foldl (fun best y => if f y < f best then y else best) b) ≤ f y

  intro α β _ f L
  induction L with

  | cons a t ih =>

    by_cases hlt : f a < f b
    · rw [if_pos hlt]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih a

      · rcases h1 with h | h

        · exact h2
        · exact h3 x hx'
    · rw [if_neg hlt]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih b
      refine ⟨?_, h2, ?_⟩
      · rcases h1 with h | h
        · left; exact h
        · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a h

        · exact h3 x hx'

    hperm.nodup_iff.mpr (nodup_eraseDups nums)

    hperm.length_eq
  generalize hM : nums.eraseDups.mergeSort (fun x y => decide (nums.count y ≤ nums.count x)) = M at hsorted hnd hlen

lemmas.name: exit102
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : Array Int) (target : Int) (h : twoSum_precond nums target) (i a b : Nat) (found : Bool), (i ≤ nums.size ∧ (found = true → a < b ∧ b < nums.size ∧ nums[a]! + nums[b]! = target ∧ (∀ i' j', i' < a → i' < j' → j' < nums.size → nums[i']! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ ∀ j', a < j' → j' < b → nums[a]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ (found = false → ∀ i' j', i' < i → i' < j' → j' < nums.size → nums[i']! + nums[j']! ≠ target)) → ¬ (i < nums.size ∧ found = false) → twoSum_postcond nums target (a, b) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums target h i a b found hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hi, hf1, hf2⟩ := hinv
  unfold twoSum_postcond
  by_cases hf : found = true
  · obtain ⟨hab, hb, hs, h1, h2⟩ := hf1 hf
    have hb' : b < nums.toList.length := by simpa using hb
    have hab' : a < nums.size := by omega
    obtain ⟨l1, l2⟩ := Refine.ts_lex_all nums.toList target a b hb'
      (fun i' j' hi' hij hj => by
        have hj' : j' < nums.size := by simpa using hj
        rw [Refine.toList_getElem_bang nums i' (by omega), Refine.toList_getElem_bang nums j' hj']
        exact h1 i' j' hi' hij hj')
      (fun j' ha hjb => by
        rw [Refine.toList_getElem_bang nums a hab', Refine.toList_getElem_bang nums j' (by omega)]
        exact h2 j' ha hjb)
    rw [Refine.toList_getElem_bang nums a hab'] at l2
    exact ⟨hab, hb, hs, l1, l2⟩
  · exfalso
    have hff : found = false := by simpa using hf
    have hin : i = nums.size := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hn ⟨by omega, hff⟩
    apply h.2
    exact Refine.ts_pairwise_none nums.toList target (fun i' j' hij hj => by
      have hj' : j' < nums.size := by simpa using hj
      rw [Refine.toList_getElem_bang nums i' (by omega), Refine.toList_getElem_bang nums j' hj']
      exact hf2 hff i' j' (by omega) hij hj')

lemmas.name: find_key

lemmas.name: upd104
lemmas.statement: ∀ (m1 m2 : Map Int Int) (h : update_map_precond m1 m2), update_map_postcond m1 m2 (Map.mk (((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries).mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1)))) h
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro m1 m2 h
  obtain ⟨hn1, hn2⟩ := h
  have hperm := List.mergeSort_perm ((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries)
    (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1))
  generalize hS : ((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries).mergeSort
      (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1)) = S at hperm
  have hkeys : ((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries).map Prod.fst |>.Nodup := by
    rw [List.map_append, List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨?_, hn2, ?_⟩
    · exact (hn1.sublist (List.Sublist.map _ (List.filter_sublist)))
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      subst hab
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
      have := (List.mem_filter.mp hp).2
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hb
      have : (m2.entries.any (fun q' => q'.1 == p.1)) = true :=
        List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨q, hq, by simp [hqe]⟩
      simp_all
  have hSkeys : (S.map Prod.fst).Nodup := (hperm.map Prod.fst).nodup_iff.mpr hkeys
  have hsorted : List.Pairwise (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1) = true) S := by
    rw [← hS]
    exact List.pairwise_mergeSort (by intro a b c h1 h2; simp at *; omega) (by intro a b; simp; omega) _
  have hfind : ∀ x, x ∈ S → find? (⟨S⟩ : Map Int Int) x.1 = some x.2 := by
    intro x hx
    show (S.find? (fun p => p.1 == x.1)).map (·.2) = some x.2
    rw [find_key S hSkeys x hx]; rfl
  unfold update_map_postcond
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hsorted.imp (fun h => by simpa using h)
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro x hx
    have hxS : x ∈ S := hperm.mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hx))
    exact decide_eq_true (hfind x hxS)
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro x hx
    show (match (m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == x.1)).map (·.2) with
      | some _ => true
      | none => decide (find? (⟨S⟩ : Map Int Int) x.1 = some x.2)) = true

    | some y => simp

        | none => decide (y.2 = v))
      | none => decide ((m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1)).map (·.2) = some y.2)) = true
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hyU with hf | hm2

        List.find?_eq_none.mpr (fun q hq hqy => by
          have := List.any_eq_false.mp hany q hq

      rw [h1, h2]; simp
    · have h2 : m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1) = some y := find_key m2.entries hn2 y hm2
      rw [h2]
      cases h1 : m1.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1) <;> simp

lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : String) (h : findFirstRepeatedChar_precond s), findFirstRepeatedChar_postcond s (match (List.range s.toList.length).find? (fun i => decide (s.toList[i]! ∈ s.toList.take i)) with | none => none | some i => some s.toList[i]!) h
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro s h
  unfold findFirstRepeatedChar_postcond
  dsimp only
  generalize s.toList = cs
  cases hf : (List.range cs.length).find? (fun i => decide (cs[i]! ∈ cs.take i)) with
  | none =>
    show List.Pairwise (· ≠ ·) cs
    have hnone := List.find?_eq_none.mp hf
    have := nodup_of_no_rep cs cs.length (le_refl _) (fun i hi => by
      have := hnone i (List.mem_range.mpr hi)
      simpa using this)
    simpa using this
  | some i =>
    show _ ∧ _
    obtain ⟨hp0, k, hk, hki, hbefore⟩ := List.find?_eq_some_iff_getElem.mp hf
    simp only [List.getElem_range] at hki hbefore
    subst hki
    have hi : k < cs.length := by simpa using hk
    have hp : cs[k]! ∈ cs.take k := by simpa using hp0
    have hmin : ∀ j, j < k → cs[j]! ∉ cs.take j := by
      intro j hj hmem
      have := hbefore j (by omega)
      have h' : decide (cs[j]! ∈ cs.take j) = true := decide_eq_true hmem
      rw [h'] at this
      simp at this
    have hnd := nodup_of_no_rep cs k (by omega) hmin
    obtain ⟨c, hcs⟩ : ∃ c, cs[k]? = some c := ⟨cs[k], List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi⟩
    have hck : cs[k]! = c := by
      rw [getElem!_pos cs k hi]
      have := hcs; rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi] at this; exact Option.some.inj this
    have hckk : cs[k] = c := by
      have := hcs; rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi] at this; exact Option.some.inj this
    rw [hck] at hp ⊢
    have hp1 : cs.idxOf c < k := by
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hjc⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hp
      have hj' : j < k := by simp at hj; omega
      have hjs : j < cs.length := by omega
      have h1 : cs[j]? = some c := by
        rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hjs]; simp at hjc; simp [hjc]
      have := idxOf_le_of_getElem_c cs j c h1
      omega
    have hidx : cs.zipIdx.findIdx (fun (x, i) => x = c && i ≠ cs.idxOf c) = k := by
      rw [List.findIdx_eq (by simpa using hi)]
      constructor
      · simp only [List.getElem_zipIdx, hckk]
        simp; omega
      · intro j hj
        simp only [List.getElem_zipIdx]
        have hjl : j < cs.length := by omega
        by_cases hc : cs[j] = c
        · have hcj : cs[j]? = some c := by rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hjl, hc]
          have hpj : j = cs.idxOf c := by
            rcases lt_trichotomy j (cs.idxOf c) with h | h | h
            · have hle := idxOf_le_of_getElem_c cs j c hcj
              omega
            · exact h
            · exfalso
              have hpl : cs.idxOf c < cs.length := by omega
              have hcp : cs[cs.idxOf c]'hpl = c := List.getElem_idxOf hpl
              have := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hnd (cs.idxOf c) j (by simp; omega) (by simp; omega) h
              simp only [List.getElem_take] at this
              apply this
              rw [hcp, hc]
          simp [hc, hpj]
        · simp [hc]
    have hcount : cs.count c ≥ 2 := by
      have h1 : 0 < (cs.take k).count c := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hp
      have h2 : 0 < (cs.drop k).count c := by
        apply List.count_pos_iff.mpr
        rw [List.mem_iff_getElem]
        exact ⟨0, by simp; omega, by simp [hckk]⟩
      have := List.count_append (a := c) (l₁ := cs.take k) (l₂ := cs.drop k)
      rw [List.take_append_drop] at this
      omega
    refine ⟨hcount, ?_⟩
    show List.Pairwise (· ≠ ·) (cs.take (cs.zipIdx.findIdx (fun (x, i) => x = c && i ≠ cs.idxOf c)))
    rw [hidx]; exact hnd

lemmas.name: step40
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : Array Int) (m r : Int) (found : Bool) (i : Nat), ((∃ idx, idx < s.size ∧ s[idx]! = m) ∧ ∀ k, k < s.size → m ≤ s[k]!) → i < s.size → (i ≤ s.size ∧ (found = true → (∃ idx, idx < i ∧ s[idx]! = r) ∧ m < r ∧ ∀ k, k < i → m < s[k]! → r ≤ s[k]!) ∧ (found = false → ∀ k, k < i → s[k]! = m)) → (i + 1 ≤ s.size ∧ ((if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then true else found) = true → (∃ idx, idx < i + 1 ∧ s[idx]! = (if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then s[i]! else r)) ∧ m < (if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then s[i]! else r) ∧ ∀ k, k < i + 1 → m < s[k]! → (if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then s[i]! else r) ≤ s[k]!) ∧ ((if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then true else found) = false → ∀ k, k < i + 1 → s[k]! = m))

by intro s m r found i hm hi hinv
  obtain ⟨hle, ht, hf⟩ := hinv
  have hmin := hm.2
  by_cases hc : m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r)
  · rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc]
    have hmi := hc.1
    refine ⟨by omega, fun _ => ⟨⟨i, by omega, rfl⟩, hmi, ?_⟩, fun h => by simp at h⟩
    intro k hk hmk
    by_cases hk' : k = i
    · subst hk'; exact le_refl _
    · have hkl : k < i := by omega
      by_cases hfd : found = true
      · have := (ht hfd).2.2 k hkl hmk
        rcases hc.2 with h0 | h0
        · rw [hfd] at h0; simp at h0
        · omega
      · have hf0 : found = false := by simpa using hfd
        have := hf hf0 k hkl; omega
  · rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc]
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hfd
      obtain ⟨⟨idx, hidx, hv⟩, hmr, hle'⟩ := ht hfd
      refine ⟨⟨idx, by omega, hv⟩, hmr, ?_⟩
      intro k hk hmk
      by_cases hk' : k = i
      · rw [hk'] at hmk ⊢
        by_contra hcon
        exact hc ⟨hmk, Or.inr (by omega)⟩
      · exact hle' k (by omega) hmk
    · intro hf0 k hk
      by_cases hk' : k = i
      · rw [hk']
        have := hmin i hi
        by_contra hcon
        exact hc ⟨by omega, Or.inl hf0⟩

by intro l

  have hs : List.Pairwise (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b) = true) (l.mergeSort (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))) :=

  · simpa using List.isPerm_iff.mpr hp.symm

lemmas.name: idxOf_le_of_getElem
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Int) (k : Nat) (a : Int), s[k]? = some a → s.idxOf a ≤ k
lemmas.proof:
by intro s k a h
  induction s generalizing k with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x t ih =>
    rcases k with _ | k
    · simp at h; subst h; simp
    · simp at h
      by_cases hxa : x = a
      · subst hxa; simp
      · have := ih k h
        simp [List.idxOf_cons, hxa]; omega

lemmas.name: idxOf_take_lt
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Int) (i : Nat) (a : Int), a ∈ s.take i → s.idxOf a < i
lemmas.proof:
by intro s i a h
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hka⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem h
  have hk' : k < i := by simp at hk; omega
  have hks : k < s.length := by simp at hk; omega
  have : s[k]? = some a := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hks]; simp at hka; simp [hka]
  have := idxOf_le_of_getElem s k a this
  omega

lemmas.name: idxOf_ge_of_not_mem_take
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Int) (i : Nat) (x : Int), s[i]? = some x → x ∉ s.take i → i ≤ s.idxOf x
lemmas.proof:
by intro s i x hx h
  have hmem : x ∈ s := List.mem_iff_getElem?.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩
  by_contra hlt
  have hlt' : s.idxOf x < i := by omega
  have h1 : s.idxOf x < s.length := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hmem
  apply h
  have := List.getElem_idxOf h1
  rw [← this]
  exact List.mem_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨s.idxOf x, by simp; omega, by simp⟩

lemmas.name: step89
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Int) (i : Nat) (acc : List Int), (i ≤ s.length ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ acc ↔ x ∈ s.take i) ∧ acc.Nodup ∧ List.Pairwise (fun a b => s.idxOf a < s.idxOf b) acc) → i < s.length → (i + 1 ≤ s.length ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ (if acc.contains s[i]! then acc else acc ++ [s[i]!]) ↔ x ∈ s.take (i + 1)) ∧ ((if acc.contains s[i]! then acc else acc ++ [s[i]!])).Nodup ∧ List.Pairwise (fun a b => s.idxOf a < s.idxOf b) (if acc.contains s[i]! then acc else acc ++ [s[i]!]))
lemmas.proof:
by intro s i acc hinv hg
  obtain ⟨_, hmem, hnd, hpw⟩ := hinv
  have htake : s.take (i + 1) = s.take i ++ [s[i]!] := Refine.take_succ_bang s i hg
  have hsi : s[i]? = some s[i]! := by rw [getElem!_pos s i hg]; exact List.getElem?_eq_getElem hg
  by_cases hc : acc.contains s[i]! = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have hin : s[i]! ∈ acc := List.contains_iff_mem.mp hc
    have hin' := (hmem _).mp hin
    refine ⟨by omega, fun x => ?_, hnd, hpw⟩
    rw [hmem x, htake]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl h)
    · intro h
      rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h | h
      · exact h
      · rw [List.mem_singleton] at h; rw [h]; exact hin'
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    have hnin : s[i]! ∉ acc := fun h => hc (List.contains_iff_mem.mpr h)
    refine ⟨by omega, fun x => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.mem_append, hmem x, htake, List.mem_append]
    · refine List.nodup_append.mpr ⟨hnd, List.nodup_singleton _, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb; subst hb
      intro hab; exact hnin (hab ▸ ha)
    · rw [List.pairwise_append]
      refine ⟨hpw, List.pairwise_singleton _ _, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb; subst hb
      have h1 := idxOf_take_lt s i a ((hmem a).mp ha)
      have hnt : s[i]! ∉ s.take i := fun h => hnin ((hmem _).mpr h)
      have h2 := idxOf_ge_of_not_mem_take s i _ hsi hnt
      omega

lemmas.name: exit89
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Int) (h : SetToSeq_precond s) (i : Nat) (acc : List Int), (i ≤ s.length ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ acc ↔ x ∈ s.take i) ∧ acc.Nodup ∧ List.Pairwise (fun a b => s.idxOf a < s.idxOf b) acc) → ¬ i < s.length → SetToSeq_postcond s acc h
lemmas.proof:
by intro s h i acc hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hi, hmem, hnd, hpw⟩ := hinv
  have hi' : i = s.length := by omega
  subst hi'
  have ht : s.take s.length = s := List.take_of_length_le (le_refl _)
  rw [ht] at hmem
  unfold SetToSeq_postcond
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro a ha; simpa using (hmem a).mp ha
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro a ha; simpa using (hmem a).mpr ha
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro a ha; simpa using List.count_eq_one_of_mem hnd ha
  · refine hpw.imp ?_
    intro a b hab _
    exact hab

lemmas.name: width90
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array (Array Int)) (key : Int), SlopeSearch_precond a key → ∀ i, i < a.size → (a[i]!).size = (a[0]!).size
lemmas.proof:
by intro a key h i hi
  obtain ⟨h0, _, hpw, _⟩ := h
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hpos
  · rfl
  · have := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hpw 0 i (by simpa using h0) (by simpa using hi) hpos
    rw [getElem!_pos a i hi, getElem!_pos a 0 h0]
    simpa using this.symm

lemmas.name: inner90
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array (Array Int)) (key : Int), SlopeSearch_precond a key → ∀ (i : Nat), i < a.size → ∀ (j : Nat), (j ≤ (a[i]!).size ∧ ∀ j', j' < j → (a[i]!)[j']! ≠ key) → ¬ (j < (a[i]!).size ∧ (a[i]!)[j]! ≠ key) → ((((if j < (a[i]!).size then (j : Int) else -1)) = -1 ∧ ∀ j', j' < (a[i]!).size → (a[i]!)[j']! ≠ key) ∨ (0 ≤ (if j < (a[i]!).size then (j : Int) else -1) ∧ (if j < (a[i]!).size then (j : Int) else -1) < (a[0]!).size ∧ (a[i]!)[(if j < (a[i]!).size then (j : Int) else -1).toNat]! = key))
lemmas.proof:
by intro a key h i hi j hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hj, hall⟩ := hinv
  by_cases hlt : j < (a[i]!).size
  · rw [if_pos hlt]
    right
    have hkey : (a[i]!)[j]! = key := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hn ⟨hlt, hne⟩
    have hw := width90 a key h i hi
    refine ⟨by omega, by simpa [hw] using hlt, ?_⟩
    simpa using hkey
  · rw [if_neg hlt]
    left
    have : j = (a[i]!).size := by omega
    subst this
    exact ⟨rfl, fun j' hj' => hall j' hj'⟩

lemmas.name: step90
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array (Array Int)) (key : Int) (i : Nat) (mm nn jr : Int), (i ≤ a.size ∧ ((0 ≤ mm ∧ mm < a.size ∧ 0 ≤ nn ∧ nn < (a[0]!).size ∧ get2d a mm nn = key) ∨ (mm = -1 ∧ nn = -1 ∧ ∀ k, k < i → ∀ j, j < (a[k]!).size → (a[k]!)[j]! ≠ key))) → (i < a.size ∧ mm = -1) → ((jr = -1 ∧ ∀ j, j < (a[i]!).size → (a[i]!)[j]! ≠ key) ∨ (0 ≤ jr ∧ jr < (a[0]!).size ∧ (a[i]!)[jr.toNat]! = key)) → (i + 1 ≤ a.size ∧ ((0 ≤ (if jr = -1 then -1 else (i : Int)) ∧ (if jr = -1 then -1 else (i : Int)) < a.size ∧ 0 ≤ jr ∧ jr < (a[0]!).size ∧ get2d a (if jr = -1 then -1 else (i : Int)) jr = key) ∨ ((if jr = -1 then -1 else (i : Int)) = -1 ∧ jr = -1 ∧ ∀ k, k < i + 1 → ∀ j, j < (a[k]!).size → (a[k]!)[j]! ≠ key)))
lemmas.proof:
by intro a key i mm nn jr hinv hg hprop
  obtain ⟨hi, hd⟩ := hinv
  obtain ⟨hlt, hmm⟩ := hg
  have hall : ∀ k, k < i → ∀ j, j < (a[k]!).size → (a[k]!)[j]! ≠ key := by
    rcases hd with ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨_, _, h3⟩
    · omega
    · exact h3
  rcases hprop with ⟨hj, hrow⟩ | ⟨hj0, hj1, hkey⟩
  · subst hj
    refine ⟨by omega, Or.inr ⟨by simp, rfl, ?_⟩⟩
    intro k hk j hjj
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst hki; exact hrow j hjj
    · exact hall k (by omega) j hjj
  · have hjne : jr ≠ -1 := by omega
    rw [if_neg hjne]
    refine ⟨by omega, Or.inl ⟨by omega, by omega, hj0, hj1, ?_⟩⟩
    simp only [get2d, Int.toNat_natCast]
    exact hkey

lemmas.name: exit90
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array (Array Int)) (key : Int) (h : SlopeSearch_precond a key) (i : Nat) (mm nn : Int), (i ≤ a.size ∧ ((0 ≤ mm ∧ mm < a.size ∧ 0 ≤ nn ∧ nn < (a[0]!).size ∧ get2d a mm nn = key) ∨ (mm = -1 ∧ nn = -1 ∧ ∀ k, k < i → ∀ j, j < (a[k]!).size → (a[k]!)[j]! ≠ key))) → ¬ (i < a.size ∧ mm = -1) → SlopeSearch_postcond a key (mm, nn) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro a key h i mm nn hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hi, hd⟩ := hinv
  unfold SlopeSearch_postcond
  rcases hd with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ | ⟨hm, hn', hall⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩
  · right
    have hi' : i = a.size := by
      by_contra hne; exact hn ⟨by omega, hm⟩
    subst hi'
    refine ⟨hm, hn', ?_⟩
    rw [Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem, Refine.forall_mem_array_iff_idx]
    intro k hk
    rw [Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem, Refine.forall_mem_array_iff_idx]
    intro j hj
    simpa using hall k hk j hj
